sources.snippet: We are excited to announce the release of Qwen3, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models. These models represent our most advanced and intelligent systems to date, improving from our experience in building QwQ and Qwen2.5. sources.title: Qwen - Read the Docs
sources.snippet: Qwen is the large language model and large multimodal model series of the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group. Both language models and multimodal models are pretrained on large-scale multilingual and multimodal data and post-trained on quality data for aligning to human preferences.
